name: Raymond Page
title: Software Engineer / IS Manager
summary: Software Engineer and IS Manager with deep experience designing and operating internal developer platforms, engineering enablement programs, and cloud-native solutions on AWS. Proven track record leading communities of practice, defining engineering standards, and driving adoption of AI-assisted engineering and emerging technologies across distributed teams. Passionate about developer experience, platform thinking, and translating complex technical strategy into measurable outcomes.

highlights.title: MuleSoft Days – Engineering Enablement Program
highlights.description: Designed and ran MuleSoft Days, an internal learning-and-adoption program reaching 53+ participants across engineering teams. Combined hands-on labs, golden-path guidance, and community knowledge-sharing to accelerate consistent API and integration practices.

highlights.title: AI / AR-VR / Cloud Communities of Practice
highlights.description: Founded and led Communities of Practice for AI, Augmented/Virtual Reality, and Cloud technologies. Provided a forum for cross-team learning, emerging-technology evaluation, and engineering standards development aligned to enterprise strategy.

highlights.title: Service AI Enablement
highlights.description: Led Service AI Enablement initiatives, partnering with business and engineering stakeholders to identify, evaluate, and deliver AI-assisted capabilities that improved developer and end-user workflows.

highlights.title: Platform & Toolchain Ownership
highlights.description: Managed engineering toolchains and internal platform components, including developer environment standards, build and deployment pipelines, and integration with enterprise systems — reducing onboarding friction and improving delivery consistency.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Design and deliver cloud-native solutions on AWS, applying infrastructure-as-code practices (CDK/CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
Lead Service AI Enablement efforts, evaluating AI-assisted engineering tools and patterns for adoption across the organization.
Maintain and extend MuleSoft integration platform components; authored reusable API templates and developer guidelines adopted across teams.
Active contributor to Engineering Communities of Practice for AI, AR/VR, and Cloud; facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions and emerging-tech evaluations.

roles.title: IS Manager
bullets: Managed cross-functional engineering teams delivering platform and product initiatives in an Agile/SAFe environment.
Owned developer toolchain and internal platform strategy; drove adoption of standardized build, test, and deployment patterns.
Designed and delivered MuleSoft Days enablement program (53+ participants), establishing golden-path guidance for API development.
Partnered with enterprise architecture and security on platform governance, least-privilege IAM standards, and cloud migration strategy.
Led vendor evaluation and relationship management for key engineering platform partners.
